name: Option Type Code
definition: Indicates whether it is a Call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a Put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

CALL.name: Call
CALL.definition: Right to buy a quantity of an asset for an agreed price at exercise date.

PUTO.name: Put
PUTO.definition: Right to sell a quantity of an asset for an agreed price at exercise date.
